fields.description_1: Before the update, Leeuwbeveiliging needed sharper page content because important security details were not always clear at first glance. Visitors needed a stronger introduction, better section flow, and wording that explained the offer in normal language before they committed to contacting the business. It made the next step clearer sooner.
fields.description_2: I gave Leeuwbeveiliging a clearer structure with sharper English copy, logical content blocks, and a smoother route from introduction to contact. The page explains the security work without extra noise, helps visitors compare faster, and keeps the WordPress presentation consistent across screen sizes. It made the next step clearer sooner.

fields.description_1: Doctorcura needed a healthcare page that reduces hesitation before inquiry. Visitors were likely comparing providers, so the page had to explain the offer quickly, show relevant details and keep the next step clear. Long or general wording would have made the service feel less certain.
fields.description_2: I created a more direct page flow with concise headings, specific project wording and WordPress content fields that remain easy to maintain. The design gives Doctorcura a clearer presentation, while visitors can scan the offer, understand the value and move towards contact without confusion.

fields.description_1: Koelcellenbouw already had useful construction information, but the message needed a calmer structure and clearer priorities. Visitors needed to scan the page, understand the practical value and see a simple route forward. The content also had to sound specific instead of broad or interchangeable.
fields.description_2: I rewrote the content and organised the page so each section answers a clear visitor question. The result explains the construction work in plain English, connects benefits to real decisions and keeps contact options close. This makes the case easier to read, compare and trust.

fields.description_1: Astenadvies needed to explain financial advice in a way that private visitors could understand. Topics such as mortgages, insurance, and planning require trust, but too much detail can make people hesitate. The website had to feel professional, clear, and personal enough for someone exploring advice online for the first time.
fields.description_2: I designed a WordPress website with calm sections, plain explanations, and clear contact moments. Services are divided into recognisable choices, with space for personal guidance and reassurance. Visitors can quickly see what the adviser helps with, understand the next step, and make contact without confusion or pressure.
